Latin title/imprint, patriarchal prescription and the editorial revision account were read directly; the native title leaf was visually inspected without a complete diplomatic transcription. The PDF's page order is the provider's order and differs from printed pagination and right-to-left reading order. edition.authority: Ignatius Ephrem II Rahmani, Patriarch of Antioch of the Syrians, addresses the patriarchate at printed pp. 3–4 (PDF pages 8–9). His decree, dated Beirut, 8 December 1922, prescribes this edition alone as authentic throughout his patriarchate and wherever its rite is observed. This is a historical prescription, not a claim of present-day authorization.
